mapper.select: select schedule_id as scheduleId, emp_no as empNo, branch_code as branchCode, start_day as startDay, end_day as endDay, memo, work_type as workType from hq_schedule where schedule_id=#{value}
select emp_no as empNo, branch_code as branchCode, name, dept, grade_code as gradeCode, status from employee where branch_code = 1 and status = 'ACTIVE' order by name

select s.schedule_id as scheduleId, s.emp_no as empNo, e.name as empName, e.dept as dept, s.branch_code as branchCode, b.name as branchName, start_day as startDay, end_day as endDay, memo, work_type as workType from hq_schedule s left join employee e on s.emp_no=e.emp_no left join branch b on s.branch_code=b.branch_code
and e.emp_no like CONCAT('%', #{empNo}, '%')
and e.dept like CONCAT('%', #{dept}, '%')
and e.name like CONCAT('%', #{empName}, '%')
and b.name like CONCAT('%', #{branchName}, '%')
order by s.start_day DESC, s.schedule_id DESC
mapper.update: update hq_schedule set start_day = #{startDay}, end_day = #{endDay}, memo = #{memo}, work_type = #{workType} where schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
